title: Consecutive non-square non-primitive tuples in finite fields
summary: Let $q$ be an odd prime power and put \[ θ_q=\frac{\varphi(q-1)}{q-1}. \] An element of $\Fq$ is called non-square non-primitive, or \emph{NSNP}, if it is both a non-square and a non-primitive element. Let $\ell$ be an odd prime divisor of $q-1$. We obtain a character-sum estimate for the number of translates of an arbitrary finite set lying in the set of non-square $\ell$th powers. Combining this estimate with a finite computation, we prove that $θ_q 3$, the inequality $θ_q<8/35$ guarantees four consecutive NSNP elements, with $q=211$ as the unique exception on the boundary $θ_q=8/35$.
